long_biography.plain_text:
Mustafa Rahmi Koç joined the family group through Otokoç in 1958 after studying business administration at Johns Hopkins University. He moved through commercial and coordinating roles before succeeding his father, Vehbi Koç, as Koç Holding chair. During a nineteen-year chairmanship, he oversaw the development of a diversified industrial and services group with major interests in energy, automotive, consumer durables and finance, alongside other sectors. He retired from the chair in 2003 but remained a director and became honorary chair.

Koç family members and family-owned companies collectively retain majority ownership of Koç Holding. The published structure aggregates personal family shares and separately lists a company named for Rahmi Koç and his sons; neither figure isolates his individual economic interest. Koç Holding's revenue, assets, market value and subsidiary holdings belong to the corporate group, not to him personally. He remains involved through his honorary chairmanship and board seat rather than day-to-day management.
